finding.claim: Embed extension emits the remote-provided embed HTML verbatim, bypassing html_input (escape/strip) and with no domain restriction unless allowed_domains is configured. Any Markdown author can make the server fetch an attacker-chosen URL (SSRF) and inject attacker-controlled HTML into the rendered output (stored XSS).
finding.source: Untrusted Markdown: a line consisting solely of an https:// URL (src/Extension/Embed/EmbedStartParser.php:34-51 creates an Embed block from it, with no host or domain check).
finding.sink: src/Extension/Embed/EmbedRenderer.php:33 returns $node->getEmbedCode() unescaped. The code is set from the remote fetch at src/Extension/Embed/Bridge/OscaroteroEmbedAdapter.php:43-46 ($extractor->code->html).

trace.note: Accepts any line starting with https:// as a standalone block
Creates EmbedParser with the attacker URL
Top-level embeds are passed to the adapter in one batch
Adapter is wrapped in DomainFilteringAdapter only if allowed_domains is non-empty; the default is []
getMulti() fetches each attacker URL server-side
Fetched HTML stored as embed code
Embed code returned raw; no HtmlFilter applied, unlike HtmlInlineRenderer.php:46 and HtmlBlockRenderer

finding.guards_checked: (1) DomainFilteringAdapter.php:40-60 scheme and host check, opt-in only and off by default. (2) html_input (Environment.php:434) is applied only in HtmlInlineRenderer and HtmlBlockRenderer, not to Embed nodes. (3) EmbedProcessor.php:45 only embeds at document top level. (4) Scheme is forced to https by the start parser. Not verified: the embed/embed library is not in the repo (no composer.json or vendor), so whether it sanitizes the returned oEmbed/iframe HTML, and what it fetches, could not be checked. Impact is stronger if it does not sanitize.

finding.claim: The allowed_domains filter validates only the submitted URL, not the redirect chain the embed fetcher follows. An allowed domain with an open redirect (or user content hosting on an allowed domain) can route the server-side fetch to an internal or non-allowed host.
finding.source: Untrusted Markdown embed URL whose host is in allowed_domains (e.g. https://allowed.example/redir?u=http://169.254.169.254/).
finding.sink: Server-side fetch in OscaroteroEmbedAdapter.php:43 (getMulti), which is outside the filter.

trace.note: Filters on the original URL only, before delegating
Host check is suffix match on the submitted host only
Delegated fetch; redirect following is not controlled here

finding.guards_checked: Host allowlist with exact or dot-suffix match (correct for the submitted host). No IP pinning, no redirect re-validation, no private-address blocking in this repo. Redirect-following behavior of the unvendored embed library is unverified, so this is PLAUSIBLE, not confirmed.
